headline.title: PSG 4–0 up inside 17 minutes, a new Champions League record, on the way to a 6–0 rout at Villarreal
headline.sub: Elsewhere, Man United came back from 2–0 down to beat Roma 3–2 at Old Trafford.

stat.label: PSG's record-fast four goals
stat.context: Paris led Villarreal 4–0 after 17 minutes, the quickest any team has scored four in Champions League history, and won 6–0.

trivia.question: Real Madrid visit AEK Athens on Wednesday. Which club has won the European Cup / Champions League more times than any other?
trivia.explain: Real Madrid hold the record, starting with the first five editions in a row (1956–1960).

rumors.title: Zubimendi ready to leave Arsenal
rumors.body: Two league starts all season; seven big clubs, including Real Madrid, Chelsea and Liverpool, told he could be available.

rumors.title: Liverpool eye Lamine Camara
rumors.body: An offer of €50m+ for the Monaco midfielder is being prepared. Nothing agreed yet.

rumors.title: Chelsea want Alex Scott
rumors.body: Bournemouth midfielder named the main January target, but he is nursing a hamstring injury.

rumors.title: Balde accepts he must leave Barça
rumors.body: Man United expected to revive interest as they look for a left-back.

news.title: Man United comeback
news.body: From 2–0 down after 17 minutes to a 3–2 win over Roma, after the worst start to a European home game in club history.

news.title: Teenager Karl leads Bayern
news.body: Bayern stay unbeaten in the league phase with a 2–0 win in Madrid.

news.title: Batrakov double
news.body: Two goals in three minutes (12′, 15′) for Galatasaray against Stuttgart.

news.title: England squad on Friday
news.body: Tuchel names his November squad; Alex Scott's fitness is the question mark.

table.note: Record shown W-D-L. Man United sit 17th on 7 points.
